findings.description: Internal use of pickle.load in pandas IO helper can lead to unsafe deserialization if untrusted data is passed.
findings.reasoning: The code at this location uses pickle.load to deserialize data from a file handle. If untrusted data is passed to this function, it can result in arbitrary code execution due to the unsafe nature of pickle deserialization. The context shows that this is part of a pandas IO helper, which may be called with user-supplied files. There is no evidence of input sanitization or restriction to trusted sources, making this a true positive for unsafe deserialization.
